smartpay.description: SmartPay is HTI's payment system (claude.md), feeding the Smart Mongol app KPIs: invoices and payments (cards, QPay and Negdi gateways), transactions and merchant settlement, fee distribution and income, merchants, invoices SmartPay issues to merchants, and VAT e-receipts (И-баримт). Source is the smartpay_db Postgres database (37 tables); 31 tables are in phase 1 under the team's columns document, people and merchants appear only as UUID tokens.
